context: MINISTRATION The usual IV dose is 16 mg/m 2 . Dosage reduction of up to 50% should be considered in patients with renal insufficiency (BUN ≥30 mg/dL) (see PRECAUTIONS: General ). The drug is administered as a single infusion over 15 to 20 minutes. Melphalan hydrochloride for injection
